notes: ACCESS: plain requests fetch worked throughout, no blocking, no proxy needed (matches the prior Home-Decor pass). robots.txt names no Claude/Anthropic agent. TREE: taken from the site's own desktop mega-menu in the homepage HTML (nav.js-nav-desktop). The Furniture tab has six columns - Living Room, Bedroom, Bathroom, Dining Room + Kitchen, Outdoor, Office - and the separate Outdoor tab expands Furniture>Outdoor's 'Outdoor Lounge' and 'Outdoor Dining' entries into their own product-type children, so those two are emitted as grouping rows with the deeper Outdoor tab children as leaves (URL-hierarchy rule). Bath Vanities is also reachable a second time under Bed + Bath > Bath Furniture pointing at the identical URL - not re-emitted. QTY METHOD: the collection grid is Algolia InstantSearch (app AVKHUU7E0V, index shopify_products) and the visible 'N results' header is literally algolia.helpers.formatNumber(data.nbHits). I read the exact query construction out of /cdn/shop/t/51/assets/algolia_instant_search.js: filters='collections:"<handle>"' AND (no stock filter, because config.stock_policy=='allow'), ruleContexts=[<handle>,'collection_page'] (collection_id_query_rules is false), facetingAfterDistinct=false, distinct off. Naive facetFilters queries WITHOUT the ruleContexts are wrong on this store - they returned 131 for sofas and 122 for nightstands against a rendered 130/119, because Algolia query rules bound to the collection context change the result set. With the replicated query every check matched: sofas 130, nightstands 119, coffee-tables 213, bathroom-vanities 21, outdoor-side-tables 59 all equal the number rendered in a real browser on those pages. Every leaf's h1 was confirmed to match the node name (all HTTP 200, no silent parent fallback). Two full reads of all 39 leaves were taken and were identical - no drift. EXCLUDED and why: 'All Living Room / Bedroom / Dining Room + Kitchen / Outdoor / Office Furniture' and 'All Furniture' (shop-all parents of the leaves above - furniture=2186, living-room-furniture=948, bedroom-furniture=338, dining-room-furniture=501, indoor-outdoor-furniture=402, office-furniture=50); 'Dining Chair Sets' (a ?refinementList= filter URL on /collections/dining-chairs); In-Stock + Ready to Ship Furniture, Contract Grade Furniture, Bestsellers, Sale, Furniture Collections, Seating Collections, Outdoor Collections, Furniture Guide, Seating Guide (nav junk / availability + programme filters / marketing collections); Pool + Patio Umbrellas (26 - patio umbrellas and pool accessories, not furniture); Outdoor Furniture Covers (42 - furniture covers/protectors, explicitly excluded); Wall Shelving + Cabinets (21 - sits under the Walls department, wall decor's job); Nursery + Kids Decor (154 - inspected the product mix: only 20 of 154 are product_type Furniture, the rest wallpaper/lamps/pillows/frames/rugs, so it is a mixed room roll-up, not a kids-furniture node - this site has no dedicated kids/nursery furniture category); all Rugs / Lighting / Decor + Tabletop / Walls / Pillows + Throws / Bed + Bath branches. AMBIGUOUS NODES CHECKED BY OPENING THEM: Bookcases + Shelving (24) is genuine freestanding furniture - bookcases and curio/display cabinets, all product_type Furniture - so it is furniture, not wall shelving; Office Storage (15) is cabinets, sideboards, a filing sideboard and bookcases, all product_type Furniture; Ottomans + Stools (71) is 67 Furniture plus 4 poufs the site indexes under Pillows & Throws, kept because the site files the node under Furniture and the 71 is the site's own number; Fire Pits + Tables flagged (see row). NOT IN THE NAV (deliberately not emitted, recorded here for the merge): the collections sitemap carries unlinked furniture collections that no navigation path reaches - bathroom-furniture (27), entryway-tables-cabinets (4), entryway-benches-stools (0), entryway-furniture (0), curio-glass-display-cabinets (22), drink-tables (33), swivel-chairs (48), modular-sofas-sectional-components (39) - plus a large set of material/style/firmness re-cuts (velvet-furniture, burl-wood-furniture, rattan-and-cane-furniture, upholstered-furniture, slipcover-furniture, soft/medium/firm-firmness-seating, preconfigured-seating, etc.) and furniture-swatches (134), all of which are filter pages under the rules.
